messages:
andrea: Morning team — quick async microcopy + post ingest standup. What I did: finished alt copy for Bench post A, updated calendar with draft publish windows. Blockers: legal flagged one usage claim on product latency, need wording tweak. Today: swap in safer phrasing, hand off to design, and queue the A/B variants.

samir: @andrea can you drop the flagged sentence here? I can suggest wording. Also FYI design needs 2hr lead time. :+1:

andrea: sure — original: "up to 10x faster than competitors". Legal worried about comparative claim. Proposed: "industry-leading latency in common workloads". Thoughts?

morgan: I like the proposed. Safer and still punchy. If we want numbers later we can cite bench with context.

leila: quick note — content calendar shows a gap Friday afternoon. If Bench post slips, we should move the partner spotlight. I can rejigger assets.

jack: pushed a tiny copy tweak to the google doc: `Update H2 to emphasize caching` and added alt microcopy for social cards. Link: https://figma.company/board/243

andrea: thanks @jack — will pull those into the queue once legal signs off.

bench-bot: [automation] scheduled benchmark run for post A on 2025-04-15 14:00 UTC — results will be posted in #bench-results.

samir: heads up — if bench numbers change we might need a small changelog note in the post. @morgan can you own that if needed?

morgan: yep I can do changelog and add a short explainer paragraph.

andrea: OK next steps: 1) legal approves wording (samir to share alt if needed) 2) design finalizes social assets (jack) 3) bench run posts results and we decide on numbers in body (bench-bot + morgan) 4) I’ll schedule the publish and tag growth. If anything blocks today call it out here. :slightly_smiling_face:

leila: blocker — design resource unavailable 11-1p PT. If legal delays till then we might miss today’s publish. Not critical but flagging.

samir: I’ll ping legal now and post the response here.

andrea: perfect. If legal says no numbers we’ll run without the comparative line and note that numbers will be updated after bench.

jack: quick QA ask — social card specs: do we still prefer 1200x628 for LinkedIn or switch to 1080? design prefers 1200x628.

morgan: 1200x628 is fine.

andrea: thanks all — I’ll update calendar after legal reply. :calendar:

samir: legal approved the phrasing "industry-leading latency in common workloads" with an inline note to add bench citation when available. Sending screenshot.

andrea: sweet — moving to design handoff now and tagging growth for scheduling. Closing out this async thread unless new blockers pop up. :tada:
